NotionError: Notion API returned 404: {"object":"error","status":404,"code":"object_not_found","message":"Could not find page with ID: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000. Make sure the relevant pages and databases are shared with your integration \"hackathon\".","additional_data":{"integration_id":"3dacd088-d5e2-8143-a778-00275fb04c7a"},"request_id":"80f4a6d7-b3fd-43e2-8e45-4fdf6bdfd38d"}
FIX: Notion returns 404 both for a page that does not exist and for one your integration cannot see. If the page exists, open it in Notion and share the page with your integration (the ... menu -> Connections -> add your integration), then retry.
